title: Healing set
html:
The Healing set is a set of equipment that increases the effects of healing, offers bonuses when you heal/are healed, and provides ways to heal allies or grant them  temporary hit points. Interacts with the Self-Heal set, which is not duplicated here.

Name Slot Effect

Absolute's Warboard 		 Off-Hand Melee (Shield)
 Heroism ( + )
Cast as a level 1 spell ( Recharge: Long rest.)
Absolute's Ward
If the wielder bears the Absolute's Brand, they gain a +1 bonus to  Saving throws.

Amulet of Restoration 		 Amulet
 Healing Word ( + )
Cast as a level 1 spell ( Recharge: Long rest.)
 Mass Healing Word ( + )
Cast as a level 3 spell ( Recharge: Long rest.)

Amulet of Selûne's Chosen 		 Amulet
 Selûne's Dream ()
An ally you touch regains 1d8⁠⁠Hit Points, but possibly falls  asleep. ( Recharge: Long rest.)

Boots of Aid and Comfort 		 Footwear (Non-Armour)
The Comeback
When the wearer heals a target, it gains an additional  3 temporary hit points.

Cap of Curing 		 Headgear (Non-Armour)
Soothing Songs
When you inspire an ally using  Bardic Inspiration, they also regain 1d6⁠⁠Hit Points.

Devotee's Mace 		 Main Hand Melee (Mace)
  • Deal an additional 1d8⁠⁠Radiant damage.
Healing Incense Aura ()

Emanating a soothing aura, You and nearby allies regain 1d4⁠⁠Hit Points at the start of your turn


Duke Ravengard's Longsword 		 Main Hand Melee (Longsword)
Stirring Execution
When you kill an enemy, allies within 9 m / 30 ft gain temporary hit points equal to your[See: Bugs] Charisma Modifier (minimum 1).
  • Charisma +2
Commander's Strike ()

Direct an ally to strike a foe. The ally uses a reaction on their next turn to make a  weapon attack.


Hellrider's Pride 		 Gloves (Non-Armour)
  • Strength  Saving Throws +1
Helm's Protection
When you heal another creature, it gains Resistance to ⁠Bludgeoning, ⁠Piercing, and ⁠Slashing damage dealt by weapon attacks [See: Bugs] for 2 turns.

Herbalist's Gloves 		 Gloves (Non-Armour)
Cleansing Touch
If the wearer heals a  Poisoned creature, it is no longer poisoned.

Ring of Salving 		 Ring 
Saviour's Allure
You restore an additional 2⁠⁠hit points every time you heal another creature.

Slippery Chain Shirt 		 Armour (Medium Armour)
Cautious Healer
When the wearer heals a creature, it automatically  Disengages and won't trigger  Opportunity Attacks.

The Blood of Lathander 		 Main Hand Melee (Mace)
Lathander's Blessing
Once per Long Rest, when your hit points are reduced to 0, you regain 2d6⁠⁠hit points. Allies within 9 m / 30 ft also regain 1d6⁠⁠hit points.
Lathander's Light
Sheds holy light in a 6 m / 20 ft radius. In combat, fiends and undead standing in the light are  Blinded if they fail a DC 14 Constitution throw.
 Sunbeam ( + )
Cast as a level 6 spell ( Recharge: Long rest.)

The Reviving Hands 		 Gloves (Medium Armour)
  • Strength  Saving Throws +1
 Revivify ( + )
Cast as a level 3 spell ( Recharge: Long rest.)
Aegis Palms
When you heal a creature, it gains the effect of  Blade Ward. When you  Revive a creature it gains the effect of  Death Ward.

The Whispering Promise 		 Ring 
Blessed Mercy
When you heal a creature, it gains a +1d4 bonus to  Attack rolls and  Saving throws for 2 turns.

Wapira's Crown 		 Headgear (Non-Armour)
Crowning Glory
When healing another, the wearer regains 1d6⁠⁠hit points.

Till Death Do Us Part 		 Ring 
 Beacon of Hope ( + )
Cast as a level 3 spell ( Recharge: Long rest.)
